title.narrative: Integral human development partner workshop - Laudato Si - Bogotá

description.narrative:
In 2015 the Church is reflecting on integral and authentic human development, particularly in the light of the Encyclical – Laudato Si’ addressing issues of climate, environment, the global economy and poverty; and the planned Synod on the Family. Reflection and debate on development, human flourishing and the impact of poverty is part of a rich tradition in the Church’s Social Teaching. CAFOD wishes to engage with this teaching, and contribute insofar as we are able to the development of Catholic Social Thought from practical, theological and theoretical perspectives. CLT has employed an expert in Catholic Social Teaching and development, Argentine priest Fr. Augusto Zampini, for a one year period, in order to enable the organisation to reflect on its own understanding of development within this framework and tradition and advance its corporate understanding. The theology programme has been asked to focus for this year on international programmes and support this reflection. Primary • CAFOD, as a Catholic agency, has a better organisational understanding of human development and flourishing and is confident in its articulation of this understanding (Catholic identity) • Local Church relationships and partnerships are enhanced through a shared and participatory exploration of our understanding of the Church’s recent teaching on development and how this might be experienced in practice • Catholic Social Thought is influenced by the praxis of an experienced development agency with a global overview of development in practice • The organisation will learn whether the methodology applied is effective in achieving the desired outcomes • CAFOD shares its final report and findings with other Catholic agencies and networks
One out of four workshops is planned to be held in Bogota - Colombia, taking advantage of the fact that CAFOD regional partner REPAM - Ecclesial Pan-Amazon Network - is organising a key meeting with CELAM and Church leaders at a regional level in November 2015. CAFOD's Head of Region for Latin America has been invited to attend this meeting along with Fr Augusto Zampini.
